documents.title: Pathology report (TCGA-Reports)
documents.text: A. Breast, left, lumpectomy: Infiltrating lobular carcinoma, Nottingham grade I (of III) [tubules. 3/3, nuclei 1/3, mitoses 1/3; Nottingham score 5/9], forming a 2.2 x 2.1 x 1.6 cm mass. Angiolymphatic invasion is absent. The non-neoplastic breast parenchyma shows. nonproliferative fibrocystic changes. Biopsy site changes present. All surgical resection margins. are negative for tumor (minimum tumor free margin, 0.4 cm, deep margin, and 0.6 cm, anterior. margin). B. Lymph node, left, sentinel biopsy: One (of 2) axillary sentinel lymph nodes is positive with. multiple (5) metastases, the largest measuring 3.5 mm in greatest dimension. Extranodal. extension is focally present. With available surgical material [AJCCpT2N1(sn)], (7th edition, 2010).
